products.title: Wicker Giraffe
products.description_html:
Wild Style.

A breezy, tropical decorating classic, our wicker wall art is the Palm Beach moment your walls have been waiting for. Large and in charge, perfect above a fireplace or in a stairwell. Feats of craftsmanship with a slightly surreal feel, each oversized Wicker Giraffe is weaved by a single artisan over the course of four days. After the reeds are hand-soaked and woven, an additional two days is spent trimming and sanding the sculpture by hand. Each piece is then coated with a clear lacquer to enhance the natural rattan coloring.

Measurements

46cm W, 46cm D, 149.86 H
